glosses: digit: finger or toe, literally translated as "finger" and thought of that way by Spanish-speaking learners of English
thimble (a small device to protect a thumb or finger during sewing)
finger (the width of a finger as an approximate unit of length)

examples.text: Tenemos cinco dedos en cada mano.
examples.en: We have five fingers on each hand.
I had no feeling in my fingers.

examples.text: Me acabo de cortar el dedo.
No siento mis dedos del pie.
